start_charter_00.t: Skybound Ground, radio check loud and clear. Runway three six, you are cleared for takeoff. Go find us something new.

start_charter_01.t: Morning. Charter is filed, runway three six is yours. Cleared for takeoff.

start_charter_02.t: You are lined up on three six. Cleared for takeoff. Good hunting out there.

start_charter_03.t: Skybound Ground. Charter on file, three landmarks waiting. Runway three six, cleared for takeoff.

start_charter_04.t: Runway three six, cleared for takeoff. The map is blank, so bring it back full.

start_charter_05.t: Got your charter. Nothing on this chart yet but rumours. Cleared for takeoff, three six.

start_charter_06.t: Ground here. Weather is checked, fuel is topped up. Three six, cleared for takeoff.

start_charter_07.t: All yours. Runway three six, cleared for takeoff. Fly low, fly steady, and come home in one piece.

start_explore_00.t: No charter today? Fair enough. Runway three six, cleared for takeoff. Chart whatever you like.

start_explore_01.t: Free flight, copy. The whole world is uncharted. Three six, cleared for takeoff.

start_explore_02.t: Cleared for takeoff, three six. No schedule, no route. Just go and see what is out there.

start_explore_03.t: Explorer flight approved. Every question mark out there is yours to name. Cleared for takeoff.

start_explore_04.t: Skybound Ground. Runway three six, cleared for takeoff. Bring back a good story.

start_explore_05.t: Copy, sightseeing. Three six is clear. Off you go.

start_cargo_00.t: Bush pilot desk is open. Check the job board, pick a load, and we will get you moving.

start_cargo_01.t: Morning. We have freight stacking up in the hangar. Take your pick from the board.

start_cargo_02.t: Ground here. Three jobs on the board, all paying. Choose one and we will load you up.

start_cargo_03.t: Cargo desk. Folks out at the strips are waiting on you. Pick a delivery.

start_cargo_04.t: The board is full today. Pick a job, and mind the weight on climb out.

start_daily_00.t: Daily charter, copy. Every pilot flies this one today, so make it count. Cleared for takeoff, three six.

start_daily_01.t: Same world, same route, every pilot today. Let us see what you have got. Cleared for takeoff.

start_daily_02.t: Daily charter on file. The clock starts now. Runway three six, cleared for takeoff.

start_daily_03.t: Everyone is flying this one today. Beat them. Cleared for takeoff, three six.

start_strip_00.t: Fresh aircraft is ready at the strip. Clear to depart at your discretion.

start_strip_01.t: You are back on the strip. Departure at your own discretion. Watch the trees.

start_strip_02.t: Strip departure, no traffic reported. Go when ready.

start_strip_03.t: Bush strip, you are clear to go. Plenty of grass, not much else.

wx_rain_00.t: Heads up, showers moving through the area. Expect reduced visibility.

wx_rain_01.t: Rain in the area today. Keep your eyes on the instruments if it closes in.

wx_rain_02.t: We have rain on the field. Windscreen will be busy, take it easy.

wx_rain_03.t: Light rain reported out by the strips. Nothing to stop you, just mind your visibility.

wx_gusts_00.t: Winds are gusty today. Expect some bumps on climb out.

wx_gusts_01.t: Gusty conditions on the field. Keep a firm hand on the controls.

wx_gusts_02.t: Watch the gusts on final today. They have been catching a few people out.

wx_gusts_03.t: Turbulence reported at low level. Keep your speed up in the gusts.

wx_lowcloud_00.t: Cloud base is low today. Stay below it and keep the ground in sight.

wx_lowcloud_01.t: Low cloud over the high ground. Do not go poking into it.

wx_lowcloud_02.t: Ceilings are low out there. If you lose the horizon, turn back.

takeoff_01.t: You are airborne. Have a good flight.

takeoff_02.t: Wheels up. Turn on course when ready.

takeoff_03.t: Airborne. Climb at your discretion, no traffic reported.

takeoff_04.t: And off you go. Looking good.

takeoff_06.t: Nice rotation. Radar contact, you are on your own.

takeoff_07.t: Airborne. Frequency is quiet, call if you need anything.

target_near_00.t: You are coming up on the target. Get low and steady.

target_near_01.t: Target is close. Bring it down and hold it level.

target_near_02.t: Almost there. Slow it down and give us a clean pass.

target_near_03.t: Coming up on it now. Nice and low.

target_near_04.t: Target ahead. Keep it smooth through the pass.

target_near_05.t: You should have it in sight. Low and steady, please.

target_near_06.t: Getting close. Take your time on this one.

target_near_07.t: That is your target. Line up a good survey pass.

surveying_00.t: That is it, hold it there.

surveying_02.t: Survey is running. Do not stop now.

survey_lost_00.t: You drifted off. Bring it back around.

survey_lost_01.t: Lost the survey. Go around and try again.

survey_lost_02.t: Too far out. Swing back for another pass.

survey_lost_03.t: That pass did not count. Try it again, lower.

discovery_00.t: Got it. That is on the chart.

discovery_02.t: Confirmed, it is on the map now.

discovery_06.t: There it is. First pilot ever to see it.

discovery_07.t: That is a clean survey. Inking it in.

discovery_09.t: Recorded. The cartographers will be pleased.

discovery_10.t: Got the readings. That is a keeper.

discovery_11.t: Nicely flown. One more off the list.

discovery_rare_00.t: Oh, now that is a rare find. Well done.

discovery_rare_01.t: Wait, is that real? That is a rare one. Charting it now.

discovery_rare_02.t: We have never logged one of those. Incredible find.

discovery_rare_03.t: Rare discovery confirmed. They will be talking about this one.

discovery_rare_04.t: Oh wow. That is going in the logbook with a gold star.

discovery_rare_05.t: Now that is something special. Rare find, charted.

discovery_rare_06.t: Hold on, let me get that down. That is a rare one.

discovery_rare_07.t: You do not see that every day. Rare find, logged.

charter_surveyed_00.t: That is every target on the charter. Bring it home and land at any strip.

charter_surveyed_01.t: Charter surveyed. All you need now is a good landing.

charter_surveyed_02.t: All targets charted. Pick a strip and put it down gently.

charter_surveyed_03.t: That is the full set. Head for the nearest strip.

charter_surveyed_04.t: Survey complete. Now the hard part. Land it.

charter_surveyed_05.t: Great work. Charter is surveyed. Find a runway and file it.

charter_surveyed_06.t: All three logged. Come on home.

charter_surveyed_07.t: Charter done. Land anywhere you like, as long as it is a runway.

charter_surveyed_water_00.t: All targets charted. Now set her down on the lake to file it.

charter_surveyed_water_01.t: Survey complete. Alight on the lake and we will call it done.

charter_surveyed_water_02.t: That is the set. Bring it down onto the water, nice and gentle.

charter_surveyed_water_03.t: Charter surveyed. One water landing and you are finished.

gorge_done_00.t: You flew the whole gorge. That is some flying.

gorge_done_01.t: End to end through the gorge. Impressive.

gorge_done_02.t: Gorge run complete. My heart is still racing.

approach_00.t: You are lined up. Cleared to land.

approach_01.t: Looking good on final. Cleared to land.

approach_02.t: Runway is clear. You are cleared to land.

approach_03.t: Nice and lined up. Cleared to land, check your speed.

approach_04.t: Cleared to land. Watch the diamonds.

approach_05.t: On final. Cleared to land, take it slow.

approach_06.t: Strip is clear, cleared to land. Mind the trees on short final.

approach_high_00.t: You are high. Bring the power back.

approach_high_01.t: Little high on the glide path.

approach_high_02.t: High on approach. Ease the nose down.

approach_high_03.t: You are well above the slope. Lose some height.

approach_high_04.t: Too high. Go around if you need to.

approach_low_00.t: You are low. Add some power.

approach_low_01.t: Low on the glide path, watch it.

approach_low_02.t: Too low. Bring the nose up a touch.

approach_low_03.t: Check your height. You are below the slope.

approach_low_04.t: Low and slow is how people get hurt. Add power.

approach_fast_00.t: You are fast. Bleed off some speed.

approach_fast_01.t: Too much speed for this strip.

approach_fast_02.t: Check your airspeed. You are hot.

approach_fast_03.t: Slow it down, you will float halfway down the strip.

land_S_01.t: Did you even touch down? Beautiful landing.

land_S_02.t: Now that is how you land an aeroplane.

land_S_05.t: I could not have done that better myself.

land_A_02.t: Good landing. Clean and on the centreline.

land_A_04.t: Nice one. The passengers would clap.

land_A_06.t: Good touchdown. That is a pilot.

land_B_02.t: Not bad at all. Welcome in.

land_C_00.t: Bit firm, but you are down.

land_C_01.t: Firm landing. The tyres felt that one.

land_C_02.t: You are down. Maybe a little softer next time.

land_C_04.t: That was a firm one. Everyone okay in there?

land_C_05.t: Down safely. We will call that a firm arrival.

land_D_00.t: Ouch. Maintenance will want a word.

land_D_01.t: That was a hard landing. Is everything still attached?

land_D_02.t: Well, you are on the ground.

land_D_03.t: Hard landing. Let us check those struts.

land_D_04.t: Any landing you walk away from, I suppose.

land_D_05.t: That one rattled the tower windows.

land_field_00.t: That is not a runway, but you are down. Bush landing logged.

land_field_01.t: Off airport landing. Bold. Charters still need a proper strip.

land_field_02.t: You put it down in a field. Fair enough.

land_field_03.t: Field landing, copy. Find a strip to file the charter.

land_field_04.t: Well, that is one way to land. Not a strip, though.

land_water_00.t: Nice alighting. Welcome to the lake.

land_water_02.t: Down on the lake. Nicely done.

land_water_03.t: Water landing logged. Mind the shoreline.

charter_complete_01.t: That is the charter filed. Great flying.

charter_complete_02.t: All done. The chart looks fantastic.

charter_complete_03.t: Charter closed out. Drinks are on the cargo desk.

charter_complete_04.t: Complete. The cartographers owe you one.

charter_complete_05.t: And that is a wrap on the charter. Well done.

charter_complete_06.t: Charter filed. You are making this look easy.

charter_complete_07.t: Mission complete. Proud of you, pilot.

rank_up_00.t: Congratulations, you have been promoted to

rank_up_01.t: Big news from the office. You are now

rank_up_03.t: They have made it official. You are now

job_medical_00.t: Medical supplies are aboard. Somebody needs these fast. Do not hang about.

job_medical_01.t: Medical run. The clock is ticking on this one.

job_medical_02.t: Medicine for the strip. Fly fast, land soft.

job_medical_03.t: Urgent medical cargo. Every minute counts.

job_fuel_00.t: Fuel drums loaded. She is heavy, so expect a slow climb.

job_fuel_01.t: You have got fuel drums aboard. Long takeoff roll, mind the trees.

job_fuel_02.t: Heavy load of fuel. Treat her gently on climb out.

job_mail_00.t: Mail and parcels are aboard. Someone out there is waiting on a letter.

job_mail_01.t: Mail run. Light load, easy money.

job_mail_02.t: Parcels loaded. Do not shake them about too much.

job_crew_00.t: Survey crew is aboard. Try not to scare them.

job_crew_01.t: Passengers on this one. Smooth flying, please.

job_crew_02.t: Crew is strapped in. They asked for a gentle landing.

job_supplies_00.t: Fresh supplies loaded. The strip is running low.

job_supplies_01.t: Supplies are aboard. They are counting on you out there.

job_supplies_02.t: Food and supplies loaded. Go when ready.

delivered_00.t: Delivery confirmed. Payment is on its way.

delivered_02.t: They have got it. The money is in your account.

delivered_03.t: Delivered safe and sound. Check the board for your next job.

delivered_04.t: Good delivery. The strip says thank you.

delivered_06.t: Cargo is off. Another happy customer.

delivered_07.t: Delivery complete. Pick your next load.

delivered_late_00.t: You made it, but you are late. They docked your pay.

delivered_late_01.t: Delivered, just not in time. Reduced payment.

delivered_late_02.t: They got it, eventually. Late fee applied.

delivered_late_03.t: Late, but delivered. Faster next time.

stall_03.t: Stall! Lower the nose and add power!

stall_05.t: Careful, you are losing it. Nose down!

terrain_01.t: Check your altitude, you are very low!

fuel_low_00.t: Fuel is getting low. Find a strip soon.

fuel_low_01.t: Low fuel. Start thinking about where you are landing.

fuel_low_02.t: You are running on fumes. Head for a strip.

fuel_low_03.t: Fuel state is low. Do not push it.

fuel_out_00.t: Engine out! Pick a field and glide.

fuel_out_01.t: You are out of fuel. Best glide, find somewhere flat.

fuel_out_02.t: Engine has quit. Keep your speed up and pick a landing spot.

fuel_out_03.t: Dead stick! Glide it down, you can do this.

crash_00.t: Mayday, mayday. We have lost contact. Rescue is on the way.

crash_01.t: Skybound Ground to all stations, aircraft down. Dispatching rescue.

crash_02.t: Oh no. We have lost them. Get the crash team out there.

crash_03.t: Aircraft down, aircraft down. Rolling the rescue crew now.

crash_04.t: We lost your signal. Hang on, help is coming.

crash_05.t: That is a crash. Emergency services, go, go, go.

crash_06.t: Mayday received. Stay with the aircraft, rescue is inbound.

crash_07.t: Impact reported. Get the helicopter up.

crash_08.t: We just lost you on radar. Rescue crews are rolling.

crash_09.t: Aircraft is down. Somebody get out there now.

ditch_00.t: They have gone into the water! Get the boats out!

ditch_01.t: Aircraft in the water, aircraft in the water!

ditch_02.t: Ditched! Rescue boats are on the way.

ditch_03.t: That aircraft does not float. Sending the boats.

respawn_00.t: Fresh aircraft is ready. Let us try that again.

respawn_01.t: New aircraft fuelled and waiting. Shake it off.

respawn_02.t: Okay, deep breath. You are back on the ground and ready to go.

respawn_03.t: The hangar found you another one. Try to bring this one back.

respawn_04.t: Spare aircraft is ready. The charter is still open.

tut_welcome_00.t: Welcome to Flight School. I will be on the radio the whole way. Let us get you flying.

tut_welcome_01.t: Hi there. This is Skybound Ground. I will talk you through your first flight. Ready? Let us go.

tut_0_00.t: First, power. Bring the throttle up smoothly, all the way past ninety percent.

tut_0_01.t: Let us start with the throttle. Push it up nice and smooth, ninety percent or more.

tut_1_00.t: Good. Now keep her straight and let the speed build. Hands off the controls until fifty eight knots.

tut_1_01.t: Keep it straight down the centreline. Do not touch the stick, let the speed build to fifty eight knots.

tut_2_00.t: There is your speed. Gently raise the nose. Small input, no yanking.

tut_2_01.t: Fifty eight knots. Ease the nose up, gently, and let her fly.

tut_3_00.t: You are flying! Hold a shallow climb and keep the wings level. Two hundred feet, please.

tut_3_01.t: Airborne! Small corrections now. Climb to two hundred feet with the wings level.

tut_4_00.t: Lovely. The gear on this one is fixed, so nothing to retract. Just hold a steady climb with the wings level.

tut_4_01.t: Nice. Hold that climb steady. Wings level, nose a little up.

tut_5_00.t: Now a turn. Aeroplanes turn by banking. Roll into a gentle fifteen degree bank.

tut_5_01.t: Let us try a turn. Bank gently to one side, about fifteen degrees.

tut_6_00.t: Good turn. Now roll the wings back to level. Small, gentle input the other way.

tut_6_01.t: Now level the wings. Ease it back to centre, no big inputs.

tut_7_00.t: Time for some real work. Follow the cyan diamond to a question mark, then fly a low, steady pass until the ring fills.

tut_7_01.t: See the cyan diamond on the compass? That is an uncharted landmark. Fly to it, get low, and hold steady until it is charted.

tut_8_00.t: Brilliant. Now land it. Turn toward a strip, line up until the approach guide appears, and keep both diamonds centred.

tut_8_01.t: Last lesson, the landing. Line up with a strip, reduce power, keep the diamonds centred, and flare just above the ground.

tut_9_00.t: And that is it. You are a pilot. The whole world is out there, go chart it.

tut_9_01.t: Flight School complete. Honestly? You are a natural. Go and explore.

tut_hint_00.t: Take your time. Small, gentle inputs.

tut_hint_01.t: No rush. Read the panel if you are stuck.

tut_hint_02.t: You have got this. Smooth and steady.

tut_hint_03.t: Try a little more input. Gently.

tut_hint_04.t: Still with me? Check the instructions on the panel.

chat_ground_00.t: Caravan niner kilo, taxi to runway three six via alpha, hold short.

chat_ground_01.t: Beaver one two zulu, wind two four zero at eight, cleared to land.

chat_ground_02.t: Otter five six, traffic is a Skylane on climb out, report in sight.

chat_ground_03.t: Cub three echo, radio check, five by five.

chat_ground_04.t: All stations, fuel truck is crossing the apron, stand by.

chat_ground_05.t: Beaver one two zulu, welcome back, park on the grass by the hangar.

chat_ground_06.t: Otter five six, the north strip is soft today, use the eastern end.

chat_ground_07.t: Caravan niner kilo, cleared for takeoff, have a good one.

chat_ground_08.t: Cub three echo, the cargo desk says your parcels are ready.

chat_ground_09.t: All stations, birds reported near the river, keep a good lookout.

chat_ground_10.t: Otter five six, say again, you were broken.

chat_ground_11.t: Beaver one two zulu, roger, rescue team is stood down. Good to hear you.

chat_leo_00.t: Ground, Caravan niner kilo, ready to taxi with information bravo.

chat_leo_01.t: Caravan niner kilo, holding short three six.

chat_leo_03.t: Ground, niner kilo, we have the lake in sight, descending for the water.

chat_dan_00.t: Ground, Beaver one two zulu, ten miles south with the mail.

chat_dan_01.t: One two zulu, cleared to land, wind copied.

chat_dan_02.t: Beaver one two zulu, on the grass, shutting down. Long day.

chat_dan_03.t: One two zulu, we are fine, just a bumpy one over the ridge.

chat_zac_00.t: Otter five six, looking for the traffic.

chat_zac_01.t: Five six, traffic in sight, will pass behind.

chat_zac_02.t: Otter five six, copy the soft strip, thanks for the heads up.

chat_zac_03.t: Five six, say again Ground, you are breaking up.

chat_jess_01.t: Three echo, loud and clear, thank you.

chat_jess_02.t: Cub three echo, picking up parcels, back in twenty.

chat_jess_03.t: Three echo, birds in sight by the river, climbing.

jet_on_00.t: Wait. Is that an F-16 on my runway? Who signed that out?

jet_on_01.t: Ground to all stations, we have a fighter jet on the field. Do not ask me how.

jet_on_02.t: Where did that come from? Okay. Okay. Viper one one, try not to break anything.

jet_on_03.t: That is not a Cessna. That is very much not a Cessna.

jet_on_04.t: Somebody just swapped your aeroplane for an F-16. I am not even going to ask.

jet_on_05.t: Viper one one, welcome to Skybound. Please keep it below the speed of sound over the cabins.

jet_off_00.t: And the F-16 is gone. Back to something sensible.

jet_off_01.t: Welcome back to the slow lane. My ears thank you.

jet_off_02.t: Cessna again? Probably for the best.

jet_takeoff_00.t: Airborne, and climbing like a rocket. Have fun.

jet_takeoff_01.t: Viper is airborne. That was loud.

jet_takeoff_02.t: Off you go. I felt that one in my chest.

jet_takeoff_03.t: Gear up, and away. Show off.

jet_ab_00.t: Easy on the burner, you are rattling the tower windows.

jet_ab_01.t: Afterburner lit. The whole valley heard that.

jet_ab_02.t: Full reheat? Somebody is in a hurry.

jet_ab_03.t: That is a lot of fire coming out of the back of that thing.

jet_boom_00.t: Was that a sonic boom? You just broke every window in the valley.

jet_boom_01.t: Supersonic! The sheep are going to need therapy.

jet_boom_02.t: And that is Mach one. Nicely done, Viper.

jet_boom_03.t: Boom. I think the cabins on the ridge just lost their windows.

coach_power_up_03.t: You are going to land short. Add power.

coach_power_down_01.t: Bit fast. Bring the power back.

coach_nose_down_03.t: You are getting slow. Nose down.

coach_left_01.t: Drift left, back to the centreline.

coach_left_03.t: You are right of centre. Come left.

coach_right_03.t: You are left of centre. Come right.

coach_good_01.t: Perfect. Keep it just like that.
